prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a reasonable local option to contact first: it says it works with self-employed clients and compares Marketplace and private plans, with an office in North Kansas City. Call **816-205-4664**. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/health-insurance/)

Also consider **Apollo Insurance**, which advertises individual and Marketplace coverage for Kansas City residents: **816-400-4477**. [Apollo Insurance](https://apollo-insurance.com/health-insurance-kansas-city/)

When you call, ask whether the broker is licensed in Missouri, which Marketplace insurers they can compare, and whether they’ll check your doctors, prescriptions, and subsidy eligibility. For a fair comparison, you can also use [HealthCare.gov’s Find Local Help](https://www.healthcare.gov/find-local-help/) or shop directly on HealthCare.gov. Marketplace plans are especially worth checking if you may qualify for income-based savings; compare the **total expected cost and provider network**, not just the monthly premium.
